subject: Mental Models
title: Yin and Yang
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Yin and Yang.

hook.text: Light defines shadow. Without cold, there is no concept of warmth.

buildup.text: Yin and yang, from Chinese philosophy, says that opposing forces are complementary and interdependent.

discovery.text: This idea appears in the I Ching, dating to around 700 BC.

twist.text: Western thinking often frames conflict as a battle to win.

climax.text: Look for the complement in every opposition.

punchline.text: Opposites balance each other when both are honored.

quiz.question: What does the yin-yang principle say about opposing forces?
options: They always cancel each other out
